narrative_md:
## Audit summary (illustrative example)

Baseline: 23,600 kWh of electricity and 3,400 kWh of gas a year, about $3,015 (range $2,596 to $3,570).

Within the $3,500 budget the plan selects 3 measures for $3,350 upfront, saving about $452 a year (range $330 to $569). Desk placement costs nothing and is applied first.

Replacing the packaged unit does not fit the budget. With C-PACE it would be financed at $11,500 over 15 years, with an annual assessment of $1,223. The assessment is a lien that runs with the property and an existing mortgage holder's consent is normally required. The unit itself was not located, so confirm it on site first.

Value uplift: capitalised at the rate of 6 comparable sales, the plan's savings correspond to about $6,025 of property value (range $3,883 to $8,754). This is an estimate shown beside the totals; it is not added to the savings.
warnings: LGT_LED and PLUG_MGMT may exceed budget at the high end of their cost ranges.
